findings.source_quote: “every last command and desire of Yours”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “ogni tuo ultimo comando e desiderio” with “ciascuno dei tuoi comandi e desideri” to convey “every last” as each and every, rather than as the final command.

findings.source_quote: “We are not ‘drop-outs’ because we don’t hold ‘respectable, secure’ jobs—we’re ‘sold-outs.’”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “disertori” with a rendering of “drop-outs” as people who have dropped out of conventional society or work; “disertori” suggests deserters.
findings.translation_quote: “Non siamo «disertori» perché non svolgiamo lavori «rispettabili e sicuri»: siamo «interamente consacrati».”
